messages:
maria: CI alert — audit-validator job failed on keystore golden-fixtures for customer-facing events. failing assertion: missing actor.id in some records. anyone seen this pattern after yesterday's RBAC change?

audit-bot: [CI] audit-validator — 2 failing tests in keystore/goldens (job #4821)
  • keystore_read_missing_actor_id
  • keystore_write_orphaned_event

kevin: ugh. I merged the RBAC rename (service_account -> service-account) yesterday. could that've changed the actor payload we emit?

sam: quick triage: the validator expects actor.type and actor.id to be present and non-null. if actor.id is omitted we treat it as a schema violation for customer events.

rachael: reproducing locally now. running: `./scripts/run-audit-validator --goldens keystore`

rachael: local output: `AssertionError: path $.events[3].actor.id missing`

rachael: sample event from the failing batch:```json
{
  "event_type": "keystore.access",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-02T14:12:03Z",
  "actor": {
    "type": "service-account"
  },
  "resource": "/v1/keystore/priv-123",
  "action": "read",
  "meta": {"request_id":"req_8fa3"}
}
```

maria: the golden fixture assumes actor.id is populated for user/service actions that touch customer keys. RBAC rename probably updated the identity plumbing but forgot to propagate id for service-account principals.

kevin: ack. two options: (A) make actor.id optional in validator for service-account OR (B) ensure the identity middleware populates id even for renamed principals. I prefer B — keep schema strict for audits.

sam: agree with B. but short-term to unbreak CI we can relax the validator to accept missing actor.id only for actor.type=="service-account" and flag it. add a warning-level marker in validator.

maria: plan: small hotfix to identity middleware to map both `service_account` and `service-account` to canonical structure with id. PR + golden fixture update afterwards. fallback: validator relaxer. who's picking?

kevin: I'll own the middleware change. adding unit + integration test.

rachael: I'll prepare the validator change as fallback. will add a `WARNING: missing actor.id for service-account` note in the CI output and an issue link.

security-oncall: tagging for visibility. this impacts customer-facing audit logs. if any customer asks we should be ready to explain what changed and which events were affected.

maria: thanks. kevin — please link the PR here when ready. sam/rachael — update golden-fixtures after middleware fix so CI checks the new canonical actor shape.

kevin: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1128 — fixes identity mapping for legacy and new RBAC string variants. includes e2e that emits keystore.access events with actor.id.

rachael: PR looks good. patched validator fallback in https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/234 but not enabled in prod. CI on that repo shows tests passing locally.

audit-bot: [CI] infra #1128 merged by kevin — deploy scheduled to staging.

maria: after deploy to staging, I'm going to run the full golden comparison: `scripts/run-audit-validator --goldens keystore --staging` and smoke the customer-facing sample prompts.

sam: FYI I added an extra golden case for orphaned events that previously surfaced when actor missing. we now assert that orphaned events are routed to internal-only logs and not surfaced as customer audit events.

maria: good catch. please add a short changelog note for support: the RBAC rename may have produced a small number of keystore events with missing actor.id between 2024-11-01T10:00Z and 2024-11-02T12:00Z; we will backfill/patch where necessary.

kevin: staging deploy completed. ran validator: all green.

rachael: updated golden fixtures and CI; validator is stricter again. opened support note draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/keystore-audit-rbac-rename.md

maria: excellent. closing loop: raise a postmortem? small blip but customer-facing logs were affected.

security-oncall: +1 for a brief postmortem and a checklist item to include audit-fixture smoke runs in the RBAC PR template.

maria: thanks everyone — marking resolved for now. will follow up with PMs and support with the draft. :white_check_mark:
